note: A whole rocket can be scaled by one factor now - type a factor, type the body diameter you are building it in, or pick a tube from the preset catalogue - and it lands as a single undo step, with the dialog saying what it will not scale and what it is about to do to your motor mount. Two things move numbers: a camera shroud's drag is now charged against the area it blocks measured from the tube surface rather than from its own flat base (+0.6 to +3.2 % CD, -0.3 to -1.8 % apogee), and every Composite Warehouse tube preset now uses handbook G12 density, since all four of the manufacturer's published weights imply densities no fiberglass laminate can have. A shroud's drag figure is on screen for the first time, and the undo dialogs stop claiming Ctrl+Z restores motors.
